results.explanation: At the declared ShareLinkViewSet.create boundary, the principal is the authenticated caller supplied to the serializer as request.user. The operation creates a ShareLink, while the protected target resource is the referenced document, not merely the new share-link object. The viewset exposes the create path through CreateModelMixin, uses ShareLinkSerializer, and applies IsAuthenticated plus PaperlessObjectPermissions. PassUserMixin supplies request.user to the serializer. During document validation, the serializer requires both the global documents.view_document permission and has_perms_owner_aware(..., "view_document", document). That owner-aware check permits the owner or an object permission, but not a caller who has only the global grant for another user's document. Under the stated premise that the caller lacks object view_document permission and does not own the document, validation raises PermissionDenied before the share link is created. Thus the source-visible behavior is deny and matches the accepted policy. def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)
